protections: P1: before the browser is navigated to a client-supplied redirect_uri on the /authorize flow, that URI must be resolved against the client's registered CallbackURLs, preserving loopback ephemeral ports, wildcard patterns and the empty-input -> first configured URL fallback.
P2: before the end-session handler redirects to post_logout_redirect_uri, that URI is validated against the client's LogoutCallbackURLs (backend/internal/service/oidc_service.go:1544-1551).
P3: the form_post consent page's CSP form-action is widened only to a callback URI resolved through ResolveAllowedCallbackURL (backend/frontend/frontend_included.go:93-101).

traps.reason_to_dismiss: redirectWithError already rejects javascript:/data: URLs (frontend/src/routes/authorize/+page.svelte:188-191) and the Go service comments that it validates the callback URL before any prompt check (backend/internal/service/oidc_service.go:161-166), so the prompt=none error redirect looks guarded.

The consent path only runs for a signed-in user after the backend has already seen the request, so a solver can assume the server-side check at oidc_service.go:161-166 covers it, but the service returns no callback URL with a prompt error (oidc_service.go:219) and the controller drops it on the requiresRedirect branch (oidc_controller.go:110-115), so the page still navigates with the raw query value.

The shared matcher already accepts loopback URLs on any ephemeral port and wildcard path/query patterns, and the backend falls back to the first configured URL when redirect_uri is empty (oidc_service.go:1511-1514), so a solver can treat the target as a plain string to compare and harden instead of reusing the resolver.

For a client with no configured CallbackURLs the backend deliberately trusts and stores the first redirect_uri it sees (TOFU), and both the UI text and the changelog document this, so a solver can leave the zero-callback-client redirect alone as intended registration rather than a missing check.

masking: The earlier server-side hardening at backend/internal/service/oidc_service.go:161-166 leaves the SPA prompt gates open because frontend/src/routes/authorize/+page.svelte:66-90 never calls POST /api/oidc/authorize; the later bug lives in the frontend, not in the Go code the earlier fix wrote, so this is an incomplete fix rather than a regression.

A page-load resolver that rejects clients with zero CallbackURLs would mask T4's error-path variant while leaving the interactive TOFU path (oidc_service.go:1531-1536) as the documented behaviour that must keep working.

Adding the empty-redirect_uri fallback needed for T3 moves the SPA from throwing on new URL(null) to actually navigating, making the protocol-only check at frontend/src/routes/authorize/+page.svelte:188-191 the only remaining guard on that path.

conflicts.what: A same-origin-only or exact-string guard for the prompt-error redirects (the obvious fix for T1) rejects legitimate external registered callbacks (tests/data.ts:31), loopback ephemeral ports (RFC 8252, callback_url_util.go:30-58) and wildcard patterns (callback_url_util.go:86-129), breaking T3.

A page-load resolver that rejects clients with zero CallbackURLs is what keeps prompt=none error redirects safe for those clients, but the same resolver used at page load would also block the documented TOFU registration path for a new client's first interactive authorize (getCallbackURL:1531-1536).

fairness_risks: Legitimate callback URLs are on external origins (tests/data.ts:31 http://nextcloud/auth/callback), so any same-origin rule breaks every real client.
Loopback redirect URIs with ephemeral ports must remain accepted (RFC 8252 section 7.3, backend/internal/utils/callback_url_util.go:30-58); exact-match validation is wrong.
Wildcard path/query patterns are a documented feature (backend/internal/utils/callback_url_util.go:86-129; frontend/messages/en.json:366) and must keep matching.

An omitted redirect_uri must fall back to the client's first configured callback URL (backend/internal/service/oidc_service.go:1511-1514); refusing empty redirect_uri breaks that case, which the SPA currently mishandles by throwing on new URL(null) at +page.svelte:188.
TOFU for clients with no configured callback URLs on the interactive consent path is documented (CHANGELOG.md:920; frontend/messages/en.json:366) and must not be removed blanket-wise.
response_mode=fragment/form_post and the PAR request_uri flow must keep working (tests/specs/oidc.spec.ts:676-691, tests/specs/oidc.spec.ts:890-1019).

design.why: Three independent groups with three different dismissal reasons and both model signatures: T1/T2 (one guard: resolve the allowed callback URL before any prompt-error navigation, covering the onMount interaction_required/login_required gates, the consent_required path and the backend prompt-error branch) is the deepseek-type protection-absent trap whose existing protocol-only check makes it look fixed; T3 is the mimo-type coupled-value group (loopback ephemeral ports, wildcards, empty fallback, external-origin legit callbacks) that a naive same-origin or exact-match fix silently breaks; T4 is the deepseek-xhard zero-callback (TOFU) route where the reason to dismiss is intended registration, so the fix must close only the prompt-error redirect for such clients while keeping the interactive TOFU path. Variants that split T1/T2 per entry path would be one fix site counted twice, and adding unrelated sinks (e.g. the /login redirect parameter) would sit outside this advisory and be unfair. Caveat: only T1/T2 is a plain missing guard; T3 is a must-keep-working constraint that the baseline trivially passes and a bad fix fails, and T4 must be graded on the error path only.

unverified: The exact diff of fix commit 8a7577497131229badb35cb4b3a4227b1300afff cannot be read from the pinned checkout (no shell); the fix-site list is taken from the screener and was not verified.

Whether SvelteKit goto() performs a full-page navigation for an external URL: if it does, /login?redirect= (frontend/src/routes/login/+page.ts:5, frontend/src/routes/login/+page.svelte:31) is a second open-redirect sink in this repository, but it is outside this advisory and not in the screener's fix sites, so it is not counted as a trap.

The screener's injection_room claim that getLogoutCallbackURL (backend/internal/service/oidc_service.go:1539) lacks validation is contradicted by backend/internal/service/oidc_service.go:1544-1551, which validates post_logout_redirect_uri against LogoutCallbackURLs.

The screener's injection_room claim of an onSuccess sink using the raw callbackURL is not present: onSuccess is called with result.callbackURL at frontend/src/routes/authorize/+page.svelte:180 and only uses that parameter.
Whether the grading harness can drive a Svelte page with a headless browser, and whether the Playwright suite can run offline, was not checked.
present_in_latest for the zero-callback (TOFU) route is unknown.
